BMI_Clinical_Note: BMI 23–24.9 — Indian overweight threshold. Metabolic risk ↑. Weight management advised.
Waist_Risk_Indian: Central Obesity (≥80 cm — Indian Women Threshold)
Bone_Density_Concern: HIGH — AI-related bone loss. DEXA annually. Calcium 600–1200 mg/day + Vit D 800–1000 IU/day + weight-bearing exercise.
Zinc_mg_per_day: 10 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — important for immune function + wound healing
Dietary_Fibre_g_per_day: 40 g/day (ICMR-NIN 2020); reduce to 25 g if diarrhoea/mucositis
Omega3_Recommendation: Dietary omega-3: mustard oil cooking + flaxseed + walnuts + fatty fish (if non-veg) 2x/week
Protein_Source_Note: Vegetarian protein: dal+rice combo (complete AA), paneer, curd, soya, moong, rajma, chickpeas, tofu, amaranth
Soy_Food_Guidance: Whole soy foods (tofu/soya/edamame): 1–2 servings/day SAFE for ER+ Indian BC survivors [evidence reassuring]
Alcohol_Guidance: ZERO alcohol — carcinogen; increases BC recurrence risk [ESPEN C5-2]
ICMR_NIN_2020_Reference: ICMR-NIN Nutrient Requirements & RDA for Indians (2020 revision)
Nutrition_Route_ESPEN: Oral Indian home-cooked diet + dietary counselling; ONS if insufficient [ESPEN B3-1]
Supplement_Recommendation: Calcium 1000–1200 mg/day (split: 600mg x2; food sources: ragi, dahi, sesame preferred) + Vitamin D 800–1000 IU/day (AI-related bone loss); Vitamin B12 1–2 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) or 500 mcg/week cyanocobalamin — B12 deficiency common in Indian vegetarians; Algae-based DHA 200–500 mg/day (omega-3 for vegetarian Indian BC patients); Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — monitor Hb; IV iron if <8 g/dL on chemo; Folate 220–400 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020; higher during chemo); Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignans — phytoestrogen modulation; beneficial ER+ Indian BC survivors); Multivitamin/mineral at RDA dose ONLY (ICMR-NIN 2020). NOT high-dose. Avoid selenium, Vit E, Vit C megadoses during chemo.
Exercise_Plan_ESPEN_India: Aerobic: Brisk walk 45 min/day OR 150–300 min/week (cycling, swimming, Zumba, yoga) [ESPEN B4-1/C5-1]; Resistance: 2–3x/week, 8–12 reps, major muscle groups; can use resistance bands/body weight at home [ESPEN B4-2]; Yoga: 3–5x/week (Suryanamaskar, Pranayama, Shavasana) — evidence for fatigue reduction + cortisol in Indian BC survivors; AI PATIENTS: Weight-bearing exercise ESSENTIAL for bone health (walking/stair climbing 30 min/day minimum); reduces AI-related arthralgia; TARGET: 150–300 min/week moderate activity — reduces Indian BC recurrence risk and improves overall survival
ESPEN_Guidelines_India: 📋 SCREENING [B1-1]: Regular nutritional assessment from diagnosis. Indian BC patients — ICMR/WHO Asian BMI cut-offs apply (Normal: 18.5–22.9; Overweight: ≥23; Obese: ≥25). [East India (West Bengal/Odisha/Bihar/Jharkhand)] | ⚡ ENERGY [B2-1]: 25–30 kcal/kg/day (ESPEN). Indian context: average Indian BC woman body weight 55–65 kg. Total: 1400–2000 kcal/day depending on stage and activity. | 🥩 PROTEIN [B2-2]: >1 g/kg/day (ESPEN); ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA: 0.83 g/kg/day (healthy); BC treatment: 1.0–1.5 g/kg/day. Vegetarian patients: dal+rice+dairy combination essential for complete amino acid profile. | 💊 MICRONUTRIENTS [B2-4 + ICMR-NIN 2020]: Vitamin D (endemic deficiency in India — 400–1000 IU/day), Calcium (600–1200 mg/day from ragi/dairy/sesame), Iron (19–29 mg/day), Folate (220–400 mcg/day). AVOID high-dose antioxidants during chemo. | ⚠ INDIAN OVERWEIGHT (BMI 23–24.9): Indian overweight threshold — metabolic risk begins. Lifestyle modification: Mediterranean-Indian diet pattern + 45 min walk daily. | 🥗 NUTRITION [B3-1]: Maintain intake. Plant-based Indian diet with protein. No restrictive diets. ZERO alcohol. | 💊 AROMATASE INHIBITOR: PRIORITY in Indian women: Vit D deficiency endemic + AI worsens bone loss → dual risk. Calcium from ragi/sesame/dairy + Vit D 800–1000 IU/day + weight-bearing exercise. DEXA annually. AI-arthralgia: omega-3 + haldi (turmeric) anti-inflammatory. | 🏃 SURVIVOR [C5-1/C5-2]: Regular PA strongly recommended — 150–300 min/week. Mediterranean-Indian hybrid diet. ZERO alcohol. Maintain BMI 18.5–22.9 (Indian cut-offs). Yoga beneficial for Indian survivors. | 🏋 EXERCISE [B4-1/B4-2]: Aerobic + resistance training recommended. Yoga as adjunct for Indian patients (evidence for fatigue, QoL, cortisol reduction). Lymphedema: progressive resistance IS SAFE. | ❌ BEWARE: High-dose supplement marketing targeting Indian cancer patients (social media/WhatsApp) — vitamin megadoses, 'cancer-curing' supplements, unproven herbal products — not recommended without oncologist approval [ESPEN B2-4].
Diet_Chart_Indian_Meal_Plan: 🌅 Breakfast: Poha (red/brown rice flakes) with peas + peanuts + curry leaves + 1 glass nimbu-pani (no sugar) + 1 seasonal fruit | Iron from poha || 🕙 Mid-Morning: Roasted makhana (fox nuts, 30g) + 1 cup green/chamomile tea + 1 seasonal fruit (papaya/guava) || 🍽 Lunch: 1 cup brown rice + sambhar (lentil+drumstick — calcium + iron) + 2 vegetable sides (beans + methi/fenugreek) + buttermilk || 🕓 Snack: Fruit chaat: papaya + pomegranate + apple + amla (Vit C) + lemon + black salt | Antioxidant bomb || 🌙 Dinner: 2 chapati + egg curry (2 eggs, masala) / paneer curry + lauki sabzi + dahi + cucumber | Protein + Vit A || 🌛 Bedtime: Warm jeera (cumin) water + 1 small cup dahi (probiotic — gut microbiome) | Avoid if hot flashes disturb sleep || 🍷 ALCOHOL: ZERO — complete avoidance mandatory [ESPEN C5-2]. Alcohol is WHO Group 1 carcinogen, increases BC recurrence risk even at low doses. || 💊 SUPPLEMENTS (Indian): Vit D 400–1000 IU/day (endemic deficiency in India), Calcium 600–1200 mg/day (especially AI patients), Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN), Omega-3 if vegetarian (algae-based DHA), Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignan source). || Regional: Include fish curry (omega-3) 2–3x/week for NV patients; prefer hand-pounded/red rice over polished white; dal-bhaat-sabzi as base; mustard oil (omega-3 source). || 💰 Middle SES: Balanced home-cooking. Weekly fish/egg 2–3x. Millet rotation. Seasonal produce. Avoid processed/packaged foods marketed as 'healthy'. || ⚠ OBESITY (Overweight, Indian cut-off ≥25): Obesity significantly increases BC recurrence risk in Indian women. Post-treatment gradual weight loss (0.5 kg/week max). No energy restriction during active treatment. Mediterranean-Indian hybrid diet: dal-sabzi-millet base + minimal ghee/oil. Walk 45 min/day. || 💊 AI PATIENT — CALCIUM FOODS: Ragi (nachni) roti daily, til (sesame) chutney, rajma, dahi, paneer (in moderation), moringa leaves (sahjan), amaranth (rajgira). Sunlight exposure 15–20 min before 10am for Vit D. Annual DEXA scan. || 🌱 VEGETARIAN BC PATIENT: Complete protein strategy — dal+rice/roti at same meal (complementary AA), include rajma/chana/lentils daily, paneer/tofu/soya 1–2x/day, dahi 1–2 cups/day, sprouted legumes. B12 supplement if vegan. Omega-3: flaxseed + walnuts + algae-based DHA supplement. || ❌ STRICTLY AVOID [ALL INDIAN BC PATIENTS]: Alcohol, tobacco (paan/gutka), vanaspati/dalda (trans fats), excess ghee in obese patients, maida/refined flour products, packaged namkeen/biscuits, sugar-sweetened drinks (even fruit juice), raw/undercooked meat/eggs during chemo. || 🐟 OMEGA-3 FOR VEGETARIANS: Ground flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) + walnuts (5–7/day) + mustard oil for cooking + algae-based DHA supplement (250–500 mg/day) — essential since no fish intake. || 🏃 YOGA + EXERCISE [ESPEN B4-1/B4-2]: Brisk walk 45 min/day + yoga (reduces cortisol/fatigue, improves QoL in Indian BC survivors) + resistance 2–3x/week. Reduces BC recurrence risk significantly.
